text:
Lina: Opening a docs PR to unify the console heatmap examples + add tracehook stitching guidance. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12801 — need owners for Python + Rust snippets and a short migration note for Dedicated customers.
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 12801 opened by Lina. Automated checklist started.
Oliver: I can take Python snippets and a small test that asserts heatmap bucket mapping.
Priya: I'll review the UX copy around the latency breakdown panel. Noticed the panel now shows p90/p99 separately; migration note should call that out.
Jared: Heads up: older telemetry clients sometimes send the trace header as `x-rd-trace` vs `trace_key`. We should show a snippet handling both.
Nora: I'll draft the Rust example and the serde decode section. Also suggest adding a tiny note about base64 vs hex encoding.
Lina: Example for header reconciliation could look like this (Python):
```py
# prefer new header, fall back to legacy
def extract_trace_key(headers):
    return headers.get('trace_key') or headers.get('x-rd-trace')
```
Can someone add the unit test?
Oliver: Added a pytest for extract_trace_key with 3 cases (new, legacy, missing). Will push in a minute.
Jared: Nit: For missing trace we should show how we fall back to span_id inference in the docs: `span_fallback = headers.get('span-id') or compute_from_payload()` — add a short caveat.
Priya: UX note drafted: "Latency breakdown now separates routing and decode time; dashboards that relied on the old single 'latency' metric should map to `routing_ms + decode_ms` for prior baselines." I'll attach a tiny mapping table.
Nora: Rust snippet:
```rust
// decode base64 or hex trace key
let raw = headers.get("trace_key").unwrap_or(&headers["x-rd-trace"]);
let decoded = base64::decode(raw).or_else(|_| hex::decode(raw))?;
// attach to telemetry
```
I'll include error handling notes.
Lina: There's also a link rot issue: some examples still point to `/examples/old-heatmap`. @DocsBot can you run a link-check after CI?
DocsBot: docs-bot: running link-check. Scanning 9 pages. Found 3 redirects and 1 404 (examples/old-heatmap).
Oliver: I fixed the Python snippet and addressed the mapping unit test feedback. Pushed a small follow-up commit.
Jared: LGTM on reconciliation snippet. One request: add a short paragraph for Dedicated customers about expected billing changes when heatmap bucket granularity increased.
Priya: I've updated the migration note with the billing impact paragraph and a sample mapping formula: `new_bucket = ceil(old_bucket * 1.25)`. Also added the p90/p99 callout.
Lina: Great. Merge plan: wait for CI + link-check green, then squash+merge and open a backport to `stable-legacy` with a compatibility code block.
DocsBot: docs-bot: CI completed. link-check: 1 failure (examples/old-heatmap 404).
Nora: I'll open a tiny redirect PR in the examples repo to re-route old-heatmap -> examples/heatmap-v2.
Oliver: Once redirect PR is up, we can re-run link-check and merge.
Lina: Targeting merge Fri 2pm PT after redirect fixes. Thanks all for quick turnaround.
DocsBot: docs-bot: summary - participants: Lina, DocsBot, Oliver, Priya, Jared, Nora; PR 12801 status: pending link fix.
